title: CatalogBook
description: Catalog + formula book (ARCHITECTURE_V2 §2.7): a negotiated SELL rate where a row matches the part's `matchOn` attributes exactly; otherwise a COST built by `fallbackFormula` (formula DSL v1) from the line's attributes and the book's effective-dated cost inputs, then freight, margin (with a floor), and customer discount. A catalog rate never gets margin — it already is the sell price.

dsl_version.description: Formula DSL grammar version the fallbackFormula is written in — engine-core refuses anything it does not know.

matchOn.description: Product attributes a catalog row must match exactly (default ['spec', 'variant']).

rate.description: The negotiated SELL price for this exact spec — no margin is applied on top.

fallbackFormula.description: Formula DSL v1 expression producing a COST for a spec with no row. May reference the part's numeric attributes (e.g. diameter_mm), `quantity`, and `cost.<name>` for every name in costInputs.

costInputs.description: Effective-dated inputs the fallback formula reads as cost.<name>. A name maps to one input or to a list of versions; the one in force on the price date is used.

freight.description: Absolute per-unit freight adder on formula lines and catalog lines alike (0 = skipped with a note in the trace).

margin.description: Margin rules for FORMULA lines, resolved most-specific-wins over `dimensions`. Skipped for catalog rows (the rate is already a sell price).

floor.description: Minimum realised margin on formula lines after discount — below it the line is flagged MARGIN_FLOOR (crit), never silently accepted.

dimensions.description: Dimensions margin/discount rules may match on (default: customer 100, tier 30, region 20).

source.description: AI_DERIVED / ESTIMATE inputs are FALLBACK confidence — a BINDING request refuses to price on them (§2.8).
